info.name: SmartLocker v2
info.description: Device API v2 (v7: RFID card and NFC phone tap, no card deposit any more) (docs/spec/smart-locker-v2.md, sections 4 and 6) and the v3 folder (docs/spec/smart-locker-v3.md, section 7.3). Before a run: sql/test_setup.sql. Postman Runner: run the whole collection in order. Newman: newman run docs/postman/SmartLocker-v2.postman_collection.json -e docs/postman/SmartLocker-local.postman_environment.json --env-var api_key=<LOCKER-01 key>. The LOCKER-01 key is in config/device-keys.local.properties (scripts/set-device-key.ps1).

item.name: Heartbeat
item.description: POST /api/health. Called first so that LOCKER-01 is not marked OFFLINE.

item.name: Batch
item.description: POST /api/locker/batch: only stores history, does not end the booking (v2).
